title: Patient Health Questionnaire-9
instructions: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

score.missing_response_policy: report answered count; do not classify severity until all items are answered

items.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite - being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

safety_flag.message: Item 9 endorsed - assess suicidal ideation and safety

severity_bands.label: Mild
severity_bands.action: Watchful waiting; repeat PHQ-9 at follow-up

severity_bands.label: Moderate
severity_bands.action: Treatment plan, considering counseling, follow-up, and/or pharmacotherapy

severity_bands.label: Moderately Severe
severity_bands.action: Active treatment with pharmacotherapy and/or psychotherapy

severity_bands.label: Severe
severity_bands.action: Immediate initiation of pharmacotherapy and, if severe impairment or poor response, expedited referral to mental health specialist

report.heading: Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9)
report.scoring_note: Scoring: 0-4 None-Minimal, 5-9 Mild, 10-14 Moderate, 15-19 Moderately Severe, 20-27 Severe
